note: This version has no tick freeze/step commands, so exact per-tick timings cannot be measured over RCON. Each constant below was read out of the decompiled source of the class recorded next to its value.

ticks.note: ticks between one item moving and the next
a repeater set to delay N takes N times this many ticks
pistons are block-event driven, not scheduled: the moving block entity advances its progress by this fraction each tick, so a full extension or retraction takes 1 / progressPerTick ticks

progressPerTick.note: pistons are block-event driven, not scheduled: the moving block entity advances its progress by this fraction each tick, so a full extension or retraction takes 1 / progressPerTick ticks
